mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 2% month-over-month signals weak labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month signals strengthening labor demand, which boosts consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strength periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.739 indicates weakening supply-side momentum, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 104.739 signals improving supply-side momentum, which boosts discount rate expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index below 245.03 over 3 months indicates disinflation, which lowers discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1155.0 indicates improving housing market momentum, which boosts consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in acceleration periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
